Paon Ki Jutti, now in 8K. Jyoti Nooran sings, with Shiv Panditt and Isha Malviya on screen. Music by Bunny, produced by Jaani and Arvvindr S Khaira, with a video directed by Arvvindr S Khaira.
Watch it in full 8K and turn it up.
Singer: Jyoti Nooran
Featuring: Shiv Panditt, Isha Malviya
Music: Bunny
Producers: Jaani, Arvvindr S Khaira
Director: Arvvindr S Khaira
Label: Desi Melodies
